RRB NTPC Graduate Level Fee Refund 2026

Post Date: June 3, 2026

4:17 pm

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the Fee Refund Notice for the Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC) Graduate Level Posts. A total of 8113 vacancies were announced for this recruitment between September and October 2025. The CBTST Exam will be conducted in 11 February 2026.  Candidates who applied this application form can check their Fee Refund using their Enrollment number / Registration number / Date of birth by logging into the official portal. Which has given below. (Advt No. : CEN 05/2024)

 Steps To Check & Download Railway RRB NTPC Graduate Level Final Result 2026 
  1. Visit the official regional website of Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) from which you applied.
  2. On the homepage, go to the “CEN NTPC Graduate Level”, “Final Result”, or “Latest Notices” section.
  3. Look for the notification related to RRB NTPC Graduate Level Final Result 2026.
  4. Click on the Final Result download option.
  5. A login page will open.
  6. Enter your Registration Number / Roll Number.
  7. Enter your Date of Birth / Password, as required.
  8. Enter the captcha code shown on the screen.
  9. Click on the Login / Submit button.
  10. Your RRB NTPC Graduate Level Final Result 2026 will appear on the screen.
  11. Download and save the Final Result.

 RRB NTPC Graduate Level Final Result 2026 : Important Question 
  • Question: When will the RRB NTPC Graduate Final Result 2026 be released?
  • Answer: The Final Result has released after the evaluation process on the respective RRB regional websites.
  • Question: How can I check my RRB NTPC Graduate Final Result 2026?
  • Answer: Visit your regional RRB website, click on the NTPC Final Result 2026 link, and search for your Roll Number in the PDF list.
  • Question: What details will be mentioned in the RRB NTPC Final Result 2026?
  • Answer: The result includes candidate name, roll number, registration number, marks obtained, and qualifying status.
  • Question: What happens after the final result?
  • Answer: Qualified candidates will be called for the Document Verification (DV) and Medical Examination as part of the final selection process.
  • Question: What is the official website of Railway RRB?
  • Answer: The official website of Railway RRB is https://indianrailways.gov.in/
